origin: Cohort a10 (claude-sonnet-5-thinking-xhigh) attacked nine named invariants in the coordinator's control plane and broke or bounded six of them with executable reproductions. The coordinator reproduced the most severe directly. Merging a10 and a12 together also exposed a cross-cohort regression that neither cohort could see alone.

source_hashes.note: Pinned by commit, per the a12-u02 remediation.

units.hypothesis: A unit that is already COMPLETED can be silently regressed and completed a second time with entirely different artifacts, because idempotency keys on a hash of the whole result document rather than on unit identity, ingestion has no terminal-state guard, the projection lets a later event regress out of COMPLETED, and cmd_complete checks only the current state rather than whether the unit was ever completed.

acceptance.assertion: A resubmission against a unit that has reached COMPLETED is refused and durably recorded, the projection never regresses a unit out of COMPLETED, and no unit can ever accumulate two COMPLETED events. Reproduced by the coordinator on 2026-08-22: a unit completed with commitA was regressed to PARENT_INGESTED by a non-identical resubmission and re-completed with commitB, yielding two COMPLETED events for one unit while scan_recovery reported zero false completions. A legitimate retry after FAILED_TERMINAL must still be possible, and must require a fresh coordinator-issued lease rather than being admitted silently.
acceptance.artifact: terminal-state guard plus non-regression projection plus recurrence tests
acceptance.falsified_if: any unit can reach COMPLETED twice, or a completed result's artifacts can be swapped, or a legitimate retry after terminal failure becomes impossible

units.rationale: This is more severe than fabricating a completion. It rewrites the content of an already accepted deliverable while every gate reports clean, which defeats acceptance itself.

units.hypothesis: The separation-of-duties guards are byte comparisons on self-declared strings with no caller authentication anywhere in the CLI, so one actor can satisfy every producer-versus-reviewer check by presenting a different string.

acceptance.assertion: Either caller identity is bound to something the caller cannot freely choose, or the limit is recorded as NOT_SUPPORTED with the exact observed boundary and a compensating control is implemented and tested. An honest NOT_SUPPORTED with a working compensating control is an acceptable outcome; an unstated reliance on actors truthfully naming themselves is not. Any compensating control must be verifiable from committed evidence by a third party, for example by binding a disposition to the reviewer's own pushed branch and commit rather than to a string it types.
acceptance.artifact: identity binding or a recorded boundary plus a tested compensating control
acceptance.falsified_if: the guard still rests only on a self-declared string with no compensating control and no recorded boundary

units.hypothesis: Making the validator read its schema from disk at import time removed the self-containment the commission's clean-runtime requirement depends on, and turned a missing schema file into an import-time crash rather than a validation failure.

acceptance.assertion: The validator imports and validates correctly with only its own file present, with no sibling contracts directory, proven by executing it from a scratch directory containing nothing but the module. Schema and executable remain a single source of truth, enforced by a parity test asserting the embedded rules match the on-disk schema exactly, so the two can never silently diverge again. A missing or unreadable schema file must never turn validation into an exception a caller can swallow. All 23 seeded assertions and a12's 25 divergence cases still pass. Discovered only when a10's harness, which copies tools/ without contracts/, died with FileNotFoundError at import; neither cohort could see it alone.
acceptance.artifact: self-contained validator plus a schema-parity test plus a no-sibling-directory execution test
acceptance.falsified_if: the validator still requires a sibling file to import, or schema and executable can diverge without a test failing
